notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
We’re very excited to announce that They Are Coming will officially be arriving on May 20th!

[previewyoutube=nU-SfNiDeOs;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development! It means a lot to our team! We can’t wait for you all to get a chance to play! Don’t forget to wishlist the game here on Steam, if you haven’t already.
